description: Minimal capabilities for the transparent cursor_overlay window. The overlay only listens for pointer_show/pointer_hide/screenshot_dims events and emits overlay_ready — it has no legitimate need for shell, sql, process, or arbitrary window manipulation. Defense in depth (S3/D7/D8 audit): a future XSS or supply-chain hit on a frontend dep that finds its way into this window will not be able to reach the API-key store, exfiltrate the cohort token from telemetry_queue, or terminate the app.
